This is a small beans plot, just a corner of my land. Beans don't really need chemical fertilizer like teff or maize do — they fix their own nitrogen, and money is tight so I save fertilizer for other plots if I have any. I will use seed I saved from last season, and put in my own labor with maybe some help from family. I'll weed carefully but I can't afford pesticides for beans.
